result.finding: The application uses AMQP 1.0 (Advanced Message Queuing Protocol) for outbound communication via Azure Service Bus. No inbound HTTP/REST endpoints, gRPC, WebSocket, or TCP/UDP communication is present. All messaging is outbound-only through the Azure Spring Cloud ServiceBusTemplate abstraction.
evidence: Producer.java uses ServiceBusTemplate.send() to dispatch messages to Azure Service Bus queue1 and queue2
spring-messaging-azure-servicebus dependency uses AMQP 1.0 protocol under the hood
No @RestController, @RequestMapping, HttpClient, or RestTemplate found in source code
No WebSocket or TCP socket usage found
No spring-boot-starter-amqp (RabbitMQ AMQP 0-9-1) — already migrated to Azure Service Bus AMQP 1.0
values: Outbound-only: application sends messages, does not receive
